en.title: Multimodal Perception & Sensor Fusion
en.summary: Detect, track, and connect road users across heterogeneous observations—with explicit attention to sensing quality.
en.foundation: Roadside multi-LiDAR background modeling (FRGB3D), unsupervised 3D detection (MulDet3D), and robust multi-point tracking connect sensing reliability to traffic trajectories.
en.future: Current work examines camera–LiDAR calibration drift and colorization error. Further directions include quality-aware fusion with radar, aerial observations, and cross-view sensing as suitable data become available.
en.question: How can heterogeneous observations be combined without hiding their differences in quality?
projects: Measure camera–LiDAR calibration drift and colorization error
Evaluate trajectory robustness under occlusion
Study temporal alignment and perception quality

zh.title: 多模态交通感知与传感器融合
zh.summary: 在异构观测条件下检测、跟踪并关联交通参与者，显式关注观测质量与感知可靠性。
zh.status: 已有基础 → 多模态拓展
zh.foundation: 以路侧多 LiDAR 背景建模（FRGB3D）、无监督三维目标检测（MulDet3D）和鲁棒多点跟踪为基础，将传感器层可靠性信息贯穿至交通轨迹提取。
zh.future: 近期研究关注相机–LiDAR 标定漂移及点云着色误差，并在数据条件允许的情况下，进一步探索雷达、空中观测与跨视角感知的质量感知融合。
zh.question: 如何融合异构观测，同时保留并利用它们在质量上的差异？
projects: 相机–LiDAR 标定漂移与点云着色误差评估
遮挡条件下的轨迹鲁棒性评估
时空配准与感知质量测量

en.title: Transportation World Models & Scene Intelligence
en.summary: Explore scene representations that connect physical dynamics, road semantics, multi-agent interaction, and future evolution.
en.foundation: Quality-aware roadside perception provides the foundation. The Infrastructure-Centric World Models (I-WM) preprint explores how persistent roadside sensing can connect temporal depth with spatial breadth.
en.future: Study spatiotemporal representations, semantic scene graphs, physically consistent prediction, and counterfactual scenarios. VLA and closed-loop decisions remain potential longer-term extensions.
en.question: What should a traffic world model represent to make its predictions both useful and trustworthy?
projects: Construct a semantic traffic scene graph
Explore interaction-aware trajectory prediction
Test physical constraints in state prediction

zh.title: 交通世界模型与场景智能
zh.summary: 探索连接物理运动、道路语义、多主体交互与未来演化的交通场景表示。
zh.status: 前沿探索 / 研究愿景
zh.foundation: 质量感知的路侧交通感知提供方法基础。以基础设施为中心的世界模型（I-WM）预印本探索如何利用固定路侧观测的时间纵深，连接交通场景的空间广度。
zh.future: 探索统一时空表示、语义场景图、物理一致的预测与反事实推演。VLA 与闭环决策保留为潜在的中长期拓展。
zh.question: 交通世界模型需要表示什么，才能让预测既有用又可信？
projects: 构建交通语义场景图
探索交互感知的轨迹预测
评估状态预测中的物理约束

en.title: Traffic Safety & Risk Intelligence
en.summary: Understand how observation error and trajectory uncertainty affect traffic conflicts, road-user interactions, and risk assessment.
en.foundation: Quality-aware vehicle conflict detection with spatial precision enhancement and research on how tracking quality affects conflict detectability ground this research stream.
en.future: Explore uncertainty propagation, vulnerable road-user interactions, and calibrated risk prediction. Surrogate conflict measures are not automatically equivalent to collision risk.
en.question: How does uncertainty in what we observe change the safety conclusions we draw?
projects: Test TTC/PET sensitivity to tracking and localization error
Study cyclist–vehicle interactions
Evaluate conflict detectability under incomplete trajectories

zh.title: 交通安全与风险智能分析
zh.summary: 研究观测误差与轨迹不确定性如何影响交通冲突、主体交互及安全评估。
zh.status: 已有基础 → 可靠风险预测
zh.foundation: 以空间精度增强的质量感知车辆冲突检测为基础，进一步研究跟踪质量如何影响交通冲突的可检测性。
zh.future: 拓展不确定性传播、弱势道路使用者交互与风险概率校准。冲突代理指标不自动等同于真实碰撞事故风险。
zh.question: 观测中的不确定性，会如何改变我们对交通安全的判断？
projects: TTC/PET 对跟踪与定位误差的敏感性分析
骑行者与车辆的交互研究
轨迹不完整条件下的冲突可检测性评估

en.title: Intelligent Mobility & Infrastructure Optimization
en.summary: Study EV routing and charging, mixed-traffic decisions, and infrastructure asset management under demand, behavior, and performance uncertainty.
en.foundation: Multiobjective road asset management and multiyear pavement maintenance planning address segment grouping, traffic dynamics, environmental impacts, and performance uncertainty.
en.future: Current work studies charging-station information, request timing, and queue-aware station choice for highway corridors and mixed autonomous and human-driven electric ride-hailing fleets. Robust model predictive control and coordinated routing and charging provide methodological directions.
en.question: How can better information improve decisions across transportation systems and infrastructure?
projects: Compare queue-aware charging-station choice strategies
Simulate information and demand uncertainty with SUMO
Multiobjective road asset management under uncertainty

zh.title: 智能交通系统与基础设施优化
zh.summary: 面向需求、行为与性能不确定性，研究电动汽车路径与充电调度、混合交通决策及基础设施资产管理。
zh.status: 特色拓展 / 不确定性条件下的优化
zh.foundation: 多目标道路资产管理与多年期路网养护规划，综合考虑路段分组、交通动态、环境影响及路面性能不确定性。
zh.future: 近期研究关注城际高速公路充电站信息与请求时机，以及自动驾驶与人工驾驶混合电动网约车队的排队感知充电站选择，并探索鲁棒模型预测控制与路径—充电协同调度方法。
zh.question: 更可靠的信息，如何改善交通系统与基础设施的决策？
projects: 排队感知的充电站选择策略比较
基于 SUMO 的信息与需求不确定性仿真
不确定条件下的多目标道路资产管理
